game_concept: A racing platformer set in Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass, a pass in a sandstorm: the caravan guide must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Print Tracer: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what scarab swarms changed.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass: a pass in a sandstorm
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Archive variation 9: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for History/classification review.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
